name: biobb_mddb HelicalParameters
title: Wrapper of the Helical parameters analysis from MDDB workflow module.
description: Calculate the helical parameters, backbone torsions and stiffness of double stranded nucleic acids using Curves+ and Canal. The system must include nucleic acids.
